verses.text: And you will say in that day, “I will praise You, O YHWH! Though You were angry with me, Your nose has turned away, and You have comforted me.

verses.text: Behold, God [is] my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid, for my strength and song [is] YAH—YHWH, and He has become for me salvation.”
